{{Top|leg}}
'''Central Avenue''' was a street in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Grig]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. It was at least ten [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] long. Along its length was located the [[The Free Access Grill|Free Access Grill]], the [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated Administration Center]], the [[Grig Employee Training School]], and the [[TGM Hospital]].<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
